gradeScale.data: A = figures checked against AIO (filings, event briefs, macro board) or arithmetic; B = figures cited with a named source but not checked; C = no figures or unverifiable
gradeScale.coverage: A = cross-market or multi-company; B = one sector or one company in depth; C = one ticker or one chart
gradeScale.logic: A = cause → mechanism → condition that would prove it wrong; B = cause and effect without a falsifier; C = assertion or call
gradeScale.insight: A = a reusable frame AIO did not have; B = confirms a frame AIO has, with new evidence; C = no new frame
gradeScale.timing: minutes from the event the post reads to the post, and whether later AIO data confirmed, contradicted or cannot yet judge it
